response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: The per-media-type average is the mean of the per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds (not total bytes divided by total milliseconds).
The overall average is the simple (unweighted) mean of the per-media-type averages, as the request states; only media types with at least one qualifying track are included.
Bytes is cast to REAL to avoid integer division; Milliseconds is assumed to be nonzero.
